# LokTube 1.4.0

- Restore personalized YouTube **For you** recommendations after Google login
  by preserving the actual selected account index, delegated channel/Brand
  Account, visitor ID and country/language from YouTube's sign-in page.
- Automatically attempt to repair existing 1.3.0 saved sessions from the
  authenticated YouTube homepage; reconnect once if YouTube does not expose
  the former session context.
- Fix defaulting to an unrelated US account/visitor context and use the
  operating system's country when no page preference is available.
- Treat explicitly signed-out YouTube home responses as an account error,
  not a personalized feed, with an actionable reconnect instruction.
- Preserve encrypted credentials, account-scoped libraries and guest mode.

Tests cover session context extraction and account isolation; platform CI
checks compilation, desktop smoke tests and packaging. Actual live account
recommendations depend on YouTube and require verification on the device.
